prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service
Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer based only on directory listings and reviews. A practical starting point is the **Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service**: it refers people with vehicle-injury cases to screened attorneys, and says the referral includes a consultation of up to 30 minutes. The listed administrative fee is **$40**. Call **(510) 302-2222, option 1**, or use its [online referral service](https://www.acbanet.org/need-a-lawyer/).

If you compare lawyers yourself, speak with at least two or three and ask:

- How much of your practice is car-accident injury work?
- Who will handle my case day to day, and how often will I hear from them?
- What is the contingency fee, and what case costs might I owe?
- Have you handled cases with injuries and circumstances like mine?
- What are the risks, likely timeline, and next steps?

Before hiring, check the lawyer’s license status and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of California attorney search](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/public/find-legal-professionals). Don’t choose solely by online ratings or promises about a settlement.

If you’re injured, prioritize medical care and keep copies of medical records, bills, photos, and insurance communications. Avoid signing a release or giving a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer before you understand the consequences.
